scopeAudit.boundary: COL26.8 has no exact Euglenozoa or Euglenophycota hierarchy root and ITIS has no Euglenozoa entry. The only reproducible ITIS scope is valid Euglenophycota TSN 9601; this is an ITIS-only partition, not a crosswalk for all Euglenozoa or a proxy for every Protists/Chromists species.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, taxon-substituted or package-wide name matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages needs only this descriptor and may omit the row-level JSONL gzip shard.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include the descriptor and the listed row-level shard as the same checksum-addressed bytes.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import deliberately changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, root-audit guards, fixed SQL, stable TSN ordering and deterministic gzip; no wall-clock fields or name matching.
